correction: An initial development parser rejected every item in a batch when one reason code was outside the allowed vocabulary. The corrected scorer preserves all typed item responses, counts each unknown code as incorrect, and leaves unrelated items scoreable.
primary_metric: decision, reason_code and total_cents must all equal the deterministic policy answer
shared_input_repair: Ledger events now own distinct copies of input facts, so a copied-ledger mutation affects only its selected event.
